slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 大道宗，青玄峰。
陆玄站在一间草屋前，倍感郁闷。
自从穿越到这个世界后，他继承已故师尊的衣钵，成了大道宗的青玄峰峰主。
而自他成为青玄峰峰主的那一刻，他的收徒系统就出现了，但第一个徒弟必须是女帝，才能激活收徒系统！
这不是坑人吗？
这个世界的境界分为：炼气，玄士，玄师，玄灵，玄王，大玄王，玄皇，玄宗，玄尊，玄圣，圣王，大帝……
要知道大道宗的宗主也不过圣王境，而原主也只是个修炼废柴，只有炼气期。
修为甚至不如外门弟子，如果不是他那便宜师尊留下的恩泽，他早已被赶出大道宗了。
数年来，大道宗每一次的收徒盛会陆玄都会参加，但是没有一个人选择拜他为师。
而且，陆玄的名字一传十，十传百，现在外界都知道了，很多大势力的长辈都叮嘱后辈。
“千万不要去青玄峰！千万不要拜陆玄为师！否则你这一辈子就废了！”
所以更加没人拜陆玄为师了。
陆玄叹了一口气。
前段时间，大道宗的入宗考核已经结束，明天就是招徒大会，会有人拜他为师吗？
就在这时，一道神虹从远处激射而来。
轰！
一个灰袍长老降落在青玄峰上，他的面容肃然，对陆玄一本正经的说道。
“陆峰主，你已经连续六年没有招收到弟子了！按照大道宗的规定，连续七年没有招收到弟子，就要被撤去峰主的职位，你可知晓？”
陆玄道，“我知道。”
灰袍长老神色复杂，又说道，“陆峰主，如果你被撤去青玄峰峰主的职位，你的修为和天赋都达不到外门弟子的要求，再结合你这些年做峰主的表现，按照大道宗的规定，你将被逐出大道宗，你可知晓？”
陆玄脸上一抽，“我知道了。”
逐出大道宗！
这就有点杀人诛心！
灰袍长老点了点头，直接踏空而起，头也不回的离开了，“陆峰主，明天的招徒盛会，祝你好运。”
看着灰袍长老的背影，陆玄微微皱眉。
怎么才能收到一个徒弟呢？
突然他的脑中闪过一个想法。
用灵石砸！
师尊给他留下了很多修炼资源，这些年他只用了一小部分。
明天的收徒盛会是他最后一次机会了，他已经不指望收女帝为徒了，只要收到徒弟，保住他的峰主职位就行。
他就不信了，这么多修炼资源，拿不下天才，还拿不下废柴了？
如此想着，陆玄瞬间放松了起来，胸有成竹的回到了洞府休息。
静待明天的收徒盛会！
第二天，大道宗收徒盛会正式开始，直接引爆了方圆百万里之地！
大道宗的历史苍古悠久，曾经出现过大帝，历经一次上古大劫依旧坚毅不倒，底蕴十分深厚。
《大道经》作为大道宗的镇宗功法，乃是南荒为数不多的帝阶功法，在南荒排得上前十！
因此，大道宗早已成为南荒的修炼圣地！
今天，无数通过入宗考核青年聚集在广场之上，希望被强大的灵峰选中。
众多青年向着四周扫视，看着大道宗的盛景，不由得心潮澎湃。
一座座灵峰拔地而起，其上灵力十分浓郁，化作了紫气缭绕在其上，甚至凝结成实质，而在灵峰之上，无数洞府参差其中，在云霭蒸腾之下，如同人间仙境。
远处，试炼塔和一些秘境之上，璀璨的道纹不断流转，如同星辰一般熠熠生辉，即使距离很远，也能感受到一股极其可怖的力量，整个大道宗气势磅礴，赤光氤氲，无比壮阔。
山峦交错，河川奔涌，大道宗覆盖方圆数万里之地，极其辽阔，而此时，虚空之上，一些祥瑞妖兽翱翔天际，发出悦耳的叫声，让众人感到心神澄澈，十分舒畅。
人群之中，一个绝美少女一袭红火色长裙，脸庞绝美娇嫩，修长玉腿如同玉柱一般完美，微风吹拂之下，火红色长裙也掩盖不住她那诱人的身材。
无数青年修炼者的目光，死死的盯着绝美少女。
content_en:
Daodao Sect, Qingxuan Peak.
Lu Xuan stood in front of a thatched house, feeling depressed.
Since traveling to this world, he inherited the mantle of his late master and became the master of Qingxuan Peak of Dao Dao Sect.
And from the moment he became the master of Qingxuan Peak, his apprenticeship system appeared, but the first disciple must be the empress in order to activate the apprenticeship system!
Isn't this a scam?
The realms of this world are divided into: Qi Lian, Xuan Shi, Xuan Master, Xuan Ling, Xuan King, Great Xuan King, Xuan Emperor, Xuan Zong, Xuan Zun, Xuan Sage, Saint King, Great Emperor...
You must know that the leader of the Dao Dao Sect is only in the Saint King realm, and the original owner is just a useless person who only has the Qi refining stage.
His cultivation level is not even as good as that of the outer disciples. If it weren't for the favor left by his cheap master, he would have been kicked out of the Dao Sect long ago.
Over the past few years, Lu Xuan would attend every grand gathering of disciples held by the Dao Dao Sect, but no one chose to become his disciple.
Moreover, Lu Xuan's name was spread to ten people and hundreds of people. Now the outside world knows it, and many elders from powerful forces have warned their younger generations.
"Don't go to Qingxuan Peak! Don't take Lu Xuan as your teacher! Otherwise, your whole life will be ruined!"
Therefore, no one worships Lu Xuan as his teacher.
Lu Xuan sighed.
Some time ago, the entrance examination for the Dao Dao Sect has ended. Tomorrow is the disciple recruitment meeting. Will anyone worship him as a disciple?
At this moment, a divine rainbow shot out from a distance.
boom!
An elder in gray robe landed on Qingxuan Peak. His face was solemn and he said to Lu Xuan seriously.
"Peak Master Lu, you have not recruited a disciple for six consecutive years! According to the rules of the Dao Sect, if you have not recruited a disciple for seven consecutive years, you will be removed from your position as Peak Master. Do you know?"
Lu Xuandao, "I know."
The gray-robed elder looked complicated and said, "Master Lu, if you are removed from your position as the master of Qingxuan Peak, your cultivation and talent will not meet the requirements of an outer disciple. Combined with your performance as the peak master over the years, according to the regulations of the Dao Sect, you will be expelled from the Dao Sect. Do you know?"
Lu Xuan's face twitched, "I know."
Expelled from the Dao Sect!
This is a bit murderous!
The gray-robed elder nodded, jumped into the air, and left without looking back, "Master Lu, I wish you good luck at the disciple recruitment event tomorrow."
Looking at the back of the gray-robed elder, Lu Xuan frowned slightly.
How can I receive a disciple?
Suddenly an idea flashed into his mind.
Smash it with spirit stones!
Master left him a lot of cultivation resources, but he has only used a small part of them over the years.
Tomorrow's apprenticeship event will be his last chance. He no longer expects to accept the Empress as a disciple, as long as he accepts a disciple and keeps his position as the peak leader.
He didn't believe it. With so many cultivation resources, they couldn't win over geniuses, nor could they win over useless people?
Thinking like this, Lu Xuan instantly relaxed and returned to the cave to rest with confidence.
Looking forward to tomorrow’s disciple recruitment event!
…
The next day, the Dao Dao Sect's disciple recruitment event officially began, directly detonating the land within a million miles radius!
The Dao Dao Sect has a long history. There have been great emperors, and they have survived an ancient catastrophe and are still unyielding, with a very profound foundation.
"Dao Dao Jing", as the Dao Dao Sect's sect-suppressing technique, is one of the few emperor-level techniques in the Southern Wilderness, ranking among the top ten in the Southern Wilderness!
Therefore, Daodao Sect has long become the holy land of cultivation in the Southern Wilderness!
Today, countless young people who have passed the entrance examination gathered in the square, hoping to be selected by the powerful Lingfeng.
Many young people glanced around, looking at the grand scene of Dao Dao Sect, and couldn't help but feel excited.
Spiritual peaks rise from the ground one after another, and the spiritual power on them is very rich, turning into purple energy that lingers on them, and even condenses into substance. On top of the spiritual peaks, countless caves are scattered among them. Under the mist and transpiration, it is like a fairyland on earth.
In the distance, above the trial tower and some secret realms, bright Dao patterns are constantly flowing, shining like stars. Even from a long distance, you can feel an extremely terrifying power. The entire Dao Sect is majestic, red light, and extremely majestic.
The mountains are intertwined, the rivers are surging, and the Dao Dao Sect covers an area of ​​tens of thousands of miles, which is extremely vast. At this time, above the void, some auspicious monsters are soaring in the sky, making sweet sounds, making everyone feel clear and comfortable.
Among the crowd, a beautiful girl was wearing a red dress. She had a beautiful and delicate face, and her slender legs were as perfect as jade pillars. Even under the breeze, the red dress could not hide her alluring figure.
The eyes of countless young cultivators were fixed on the beautiful girl.
